The '''Mountain Poachers''' were a criminal group of [[Hunting/Legends|poachers]] that was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The Mountain Poachers operated in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. They included beings from various species, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] and [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]]. They had trained [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatches]] to aid them during their hunts.<ref name="SWG:CtT" />

[[File:Mountain_Poachers_2.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Mountain Poachers and their narglatches.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Mountain Poachers took over a [[Mountain poacher bunker|bunker]] that served as base of operations for a group of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]], located in the mountain wilderness many kilometers south-east of the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]]. One of the miners, [[Galuf Cardaan]], then contacted [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]],<ref name="SWG:CtT" /> a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]],<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Commando|Commando|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> in order to got rid of the poachers. Snopel therefore dispatched a group of commandos under training to deal with the criminals. The commandos attacked the bunker, killing some poachers and narglatches in the assault, and successfully reclaimed the building.<ref name="SWG:CtT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mountain Poachers appeared in [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CtT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mountain Poachers were added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
